method: Executed differential (evidence tier 1): ../oracle/B8b-dbs/driver.cpp compiled with libOpenMS's Release flags against the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 and run twice on ibminode06, each case in a fresh process, both runs byte-identical. The driver builds ModificationsDB through its public provider constructor from UnimodXMLDataProvider(CHEMISTRY/unimod.xml), UnimodXMLDataProvider(CHEMISTRY/custom_mods.xml) and OBODataProvider(CHEMISTRY/XLMOD.obo); the install's three files are byte-identical to resources/modifications (sha256 22231d32..., 2078bf44..., 9792d18d...), so every record, index key, search, sort and the writeTSV file compare one to one with ModificationsDB::global(). The mods_singleton case records what getInstance() loads (3,610 records, with PSI-MOD.obo).

source_files.role: residuesMatch_, explainsMassDiff_, the name index and its pointer-ordered sets, every search, findModificationIndex, both addModification overloads, getAllSearchModifications' comparator, writeTSV.
Read for getTermSpecificityName (ANYWHERE is 'none'), isUserDefined, operator== and the default origin 'X'.
Read for getUniModAccession, setFullId and getTermSpecificityName.
